profile.summary: The Center for Relational Practices provides training and coaching in relational and restorative practices for schools and school districts. Its services include leadership coaching, strategic planning, implementation coaching, and training of trainers. It focuses on building trusting relationships and fair responses to conflict and harm in school communities.
